hero.title: Become a volunteer at WINGS
hero.description: At WINGS Counselling Centre, volunteers play an important role in supporting our mission of emotional well-being and community care. Whether through assisting events, supporting outreach activities or helping us create a safe and welcoming environment every contribution matters.

whyVolunteer.title: Why volunteer with WINGS?
whyVolunteer.description: Volunteering with WINGS is an opportunity to give back while growing personally and professionally. Gain valuable experience, build meaningful connections and make a lasting impact in the lives of individuals and families.

cards.title: Learn & Grow
cards.text: Gain valuable experience in counselling support environments, communication, teamwork, event coordination and community engagement.

cards.title: Make a positive impact
cards.text: Support meaningful initiatives and contribute directly to emotional well-being and community care programs.

cards.title: Be part of a supportive community
cards.text: Connect with like-minded people who care deeply about creating positive change in the community.

cards.title: Flexible involvement
cards.text: Choose opportunities that fit your schedule and availability while making a genuine difference.

opportunities.title: Four ways to show up
opportunities.description: Pick what fits your skills, schedule and the kind of contribution that feels meaningful to you.

items.title: Talks & Workshops
items.subtitle: Best for: confident speakers, specialists
items.description: Help us run mental wellness workshops, talks for parents, mindfulness sessions and community fundraisers. The warm welcome that makes people feel safe enough to stay.

items.title: Outreach
items.subtitle: Best for: people who love connecting
items.description: Represent WINGS at schools, community events and corporate wellness fairs. You'll spread awareness about mental health support and help people who need us actually find us.

items.title: Outings & Activities
items.subtitle: Best for: warm, patient, playful people
items.description: Help with outings for the youth and children we support like games, day trips & art sessions. This is where lifelong memories get made, sometimes for kids who don't get many of them.

items.title: Administrative support
items.subtitle: Best for: quietly helpful, detail-oriented
items.description: Behind every event is paperwork, logistics and coordination. If you'd rather support quietly from a desk than be front-of-house, this is where you shine.

process.title: Your path to impact
process.description: A simple journey toward making a difference.

steps.title: Fill the form
steps.description: A few details about you, what you'd like to do and your availability.

steps.title: Team review
steps.description: Our coordinator reads your application and calls you for a relaxed conversation.

steps.title: Orientation
steps.description: Meet your coordinator and senior counsellors. Everything you need to know in person.

steps.title: Start volunteering
steps.description: We pair you with experienced volunteers for your first events. Nobody starts alone.

whoVolunteers.title: Who volunteers with us?
whoVolunteers.description: Retirees, students, working professionals & parents—anyone with a few hours to give and a quiet kind of care to bring.

cards.title: Students
cards.description: University students looking to give back, gain experience and fulfil community involvement hours in a safe, supportive setting.

cards.title: Working professionals
cards.description: Those who want to give a couple of hours to a social cause that fits their schedule and provides a meaningful outlet from day-to-day life.

cards.title: Retirees & seniors
cards.description: With a lifetime of experience, wisdom and compassion, your steady presence can have a powerful impact on vulnerable communities.

cta.title: Ready to make a real difference?
cta.description: Take the first step toward becoming a pillar of support for your community. Our application process is warm, welcoming and open to everyone.
